verdict.rationale: Anytype's local-first architecture, encrypted vault, local-only mode, self-hosting, and import/export give users strong control over where and whether data is stored and synced (anytype-docs-29, anytype-docs-30, anytype-docs-42, anytype-docs-44, anytype-docs-20). However, there is no explicit documentation of a deletion/purge workflow (e.g., removing data from backup nodes, sync peers, or exported copies) or retention-policy controls, and a community comment notes indexes are not encrypted at rest (anytype-comm-16). Missing for 10: explicit object/space deletion and purge guarantees across synced nodes, documented data-retention settings, and independent verification of deletion behavior.
